entry.title: When Does Personality Composition Matter for Multi-Agent LLM Teams?
entry.summary: Project page for the COLM 2026 paper. Personality prompts shift multi-agent LLM communication everywhere, but outcomes only degrade on unstructured tasks: structured code artifacts buffer the effect ("artifact-mediated buffering"), while research milestones drop up to 66% and bargaining agreement collapses from ~40% to ≤1% under low agreeableness. Full results tables, FAQ, citation info, and machine-readable data APIs.
